name: Rongan Property Co.,Ltd.
summary: Rongan Property Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in real estate development and sales in China. The company develops residential and commercial properties, business stores, and office buildings. It also manages residences, stores, and business buildings. In addition, the company engages in real estate operations; asset and investment management; industrial and industrial project investment; food sales; real estate sales agency; housing rental; property management; engineering contracting; trading; enterprise management and socioeconomic consulting; construction projects; and real estate brokerage activities.
